patterns.note: A prominent full-width atmospheric video hero is followed by a clean, grid-based content layout for product and editorial features.
A distinct contrast is used between a refined, elegant serif for the brand name and a clean, understated sans-serif for all other navigational and body text.
A muted, almost monochromatic palette of dark grays, whites, and natural tones from photography creates a sophisticated and understated feel.
The main navigation bar and a cookie banner remain persistently sticky at the top and bottom of the viewport, respectively, while a full-bleed background video hero scrolls out of view.
Content sections are clearly delineated by ample vertical spacing and distinct content types, such as editorial blocks and product grids.

technique_notes: A fixed header navigation and a fixed footer cookie banner maintain persistent access to key actions and information across the site.
The hero section employs a full-width, auto-playing background video to establish an atmospheric brand presence, which then scrolls out of view as the user engages with the page.
Content sections are presented in a clean, grid-based layout, relying on static scrolling for content reveal without additional scroll-triggered animations.

design_tokens.type_scale: Understated and refined; the brand name is a medium-sized serif, while all other text (navigation, body, labels) is a consistently small, clean sans-serif, creating a subtle hierarchy.
design_tokens.spacing: airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and a balanced, breathable grid for product displays

standout: The site's design stands out for its sophisticated, almost austere minimalism, which elevates the brand's aesthetic. The use of a blurry, atmospheric video hero combined with a stark, editorial layout and understated typography creates a distinct high-fashion, art-gallery feel rather than a typical e-commerce experience.
